title: Indicator of a subset lying among free variables as a coordinate product
statement: Let $\rho$ be a restriction on $n$ variables — a map assigning each index $i \in \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ either a fixed Boolean value or the free mark — and let $T \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}$. Then the indicator of the event that every index in $T$ is free under $\rho$ factors as a product over all $n$ coordinates: \[ \mathbf{1}\bigl[\,T \subseteq \{i : \rho(i)\ \text{is free}\}\,\bigr] \;=\; \prod_{i=0}^{n-1} c_i, \] where the factor $c_i$ equals $\mathbf{1}[\rho(i)\ \text{is free}]$ when $i \in T$ and equals $1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: T is a finite subset of the n indices
ρ is a restriction on n variables
replaced:
For a set $T \subseteq \{0,\dots,n-1\}$ and a restriction $\rho$, the indicator of the event
$T \subseteq \mathrm{freeVars}(\rho)$ equals the product over all coordinates $i$ of the factor
that is the indicator of $\rho(i) = \star$ when $i \in T$, and $1$ otherwise.
